sections.overview: This marine snailfish is known from the western North Atlantic east of New Jersey, near Alvin Canyon.
sections.identification: The description distinguishes its dark head and belly from the lighter rear of the body.
sections.habitat: It is a deep-water species; the known type capture was made in midwater.
sections.diet: The consulted accounts do not document its diet.
sections.behavior: The consulted accounts give no species-specific behavioral observations.
sections.reproduction: No reproductive details are reported in the consulted sources.
sections.ecology: It is known only from its holotype, leaving its ecology poorly understood. Its congener P. melanocephalus is also known from the western North Atlantic and is named for its dark head.
sections.conservation: The consulted FishBase account does not list an IUCN assessment.
